seoDescription: Down Right Concreting in Canberra offers decorative and functional concrete services: driveways, paths, pergolas, house slabs, exposed aggregate, stencil and coloured concrete. Call 0419 635 520.

services.title: Residential Concrete
services.body: As residential concrete contractors, we work together with our client to implement a concrete solution that is unique to their home environment. This includes the detailed design of concrete structures, as well as the creation of driveways, paths, pergolas, house/waffle /infill slabs, pool surrounds and more.

services.title: Commercial Concrete
services.body: As fully licensed and insured commercial concrete contractors, we understand the importance of building sustainable concreting solutions that will stand the test of time. We’ve facilitated many large-scale jobs and helped establish many of the commercial spaces enjoyed by so many in Canberra – including the McDonalds stores in Kippax, Mitchell and Majura Park.

services.title: Exposed Aggregate Concrete
services.body: With a natural look that utilises a mixture of rocks, pebbles, silicate, quarry stones, and shells, exposed aggregate concrete is growing more popular amongst home and business owners around the globe. This option is particularly aesthetic, with the ability to be customised to your design and landscaping desires.

services.title: Stencil Pattern Concrete
services.body: For those that are looking for more than the classic cement finish, concrete stenciling offers a decorative solution with the ability to be tailored in more ways than one. With a wide variety of colours and patterns to choose from, we give you the freedom to design unique flooring outcomes for your garden, pool side, driveway and pathways.

services.title: Coloured Concrete
services.body: Coloured concrete has more to it than what meets the eye. Other than the fact that it can be used to create fascinating visual effects that contribute to your existing or potential structure, it’s cove pattern and texture fosters an anti-slip surface with undeniable grip. This is a great option for both driveways and outdoor entertainment areas.

services.title: Polished Concrete
services.body: Polished Concrete is not only functional, hypoallergenic, energy efficient it is stylish, easy to maintain and unique to each home or business. Polished concrete will stand the test of time and will enhance the design of your home or commercial property.

services.title: Grey Concrete
services.body: At Down Right Concreting, we don’t think that grey concrete is boring. Rather, we look at it as a platform to experiment, innovate and create a masterpiece. With our skill and expertise, we are able to make grey concrete look interesting and appealing. So, when you hire Down Right Concreting, you get a beautiful looking concrete surface without spending too much money.

services.title: Concrete Driveways
services.body: The list of advantages associated with a concrete driveway is a long one. Firstly, concrete is one of the strongest building materials available, providing a long-lasting solution for a wide variety of construction applications. It’s ability to resist wear and tear makes it one of the most widely-used materials on the globe.

services.title: Excavation
services.body: Here at Down Right Concreting we recognise that the perfect concrete slab, driveway or specialised job isn’t fully reliant on the premium quality concreting service and concrete that we supply. Concreting jobs with the perfect execution, ultimately leading to the highest longevity, need to be levelled by accurate and experienced excavation services. That’s why we also have DRC Excavation Services.

The driveway looks amazing. Dave and his team have done such a fantastic job. We use down Right Concreting for a slab for our shed, our driveway and for the final coloured stencil. I was showing one of my work colleagues the finished driveways when she asked 'Down Right Concreting' I asked her how did she know, and she said 'No one else in Canberra can get a finish that looks as good at that!' Dave should have left a Down Right Concreting sign out the front of our house so we wouldn't have to keep telling neighbours and passes by who did our driveway.

The suspended house slabs are first class. The finish and sealing of the Bluestone pathways is excellent. As importantly, the teamwork and good humour of your team members made it a pleasure for us to have Down Right at our residence. I unreservedly recommend your concreting services. Please be assured I am happy for you to use this communication as testimony of our satisfaction with Down Right services.

items.q: What is included in the base pricing for concrete supply and placement of a project?
items.a: Our base rate pricing is inclusive of formwork, steel mesh, chairs, jointex, concrete and labour to complete the desired works. Other provided services such as excavation and sub base are charged depending on if they are required and vary from project to project.

items.q: How soon can you start my project after approval of the quotation?
items.a: Typically, there is a 2-4 week period before the commencement of a new project depending on the current work load. Dave will be upfront with our current work load at the time of quoting. Some times are busy than others like the lead up to Christmas. We endeavour to stay as close as possible to the time frame provided at the time of approval. The weather is our worst enemy with time as rain and concreting don’t mix. If there is a delay we will contact you and keep you updated.

items.q: How thick should my concrete be?
items.a: We work using a minimum of 100mm thick concrete for all of our standard concrete projects like driveways and paths, unless specified by an Engineer. We ensure we meet all Australian Standards. When we quote a project we ask what you will primarily be using the area for and will recommend a strength of concrete (25MPA or greater) and depth (100mm or greater) to suit. For example, a driveway used for parking a heavy vehicle could be 32MPA concrete and 125-150mm deep. While the path to your clothes line could be 100mm thick using 25MPA concrete.

items.q: How long before I can use my concrete?
items.a: Concrete requires curing time so 7-8 days is recommended. If your new concrete is to be sealed, then you may have to wait another couple of days so that the sealer has completely dried.

Concrete is a popular residential construction material in Australia because of the list of advantages it offers. At Down Right Concreting, we harness the enormous potential of concrete to ensure you get robust, functional and visually appealing surfaces. None of our work is compromised, with an aim of creating concrete finishes that are unmatched in quality and workmanship. Want to learn more from a member of our team? ## Comprehensive residential concreting services

Through the years in the concreating business, we have worked with numerous builders and homeowners to design creative concrete structures for many different types of homes. We are specialists in creating driveways, paths, pergolas, and house slabs, including waffle slabs and infill slabs, pool surrounds, extension slabs and more.

Our dedication to great quality work is especially apparent in our concrete driveway outcomes, where exceptional attention to detail is accompanied with ultimate durability and functionality. Want to see it for yourself? View our gallery.

We create different concrete surfaces such as plain grey, coloured, and patterned. Additionally, our concrete services include the re-sealing and cleaning of existing concrete surfaces. This also includes concrete floors and walkways.

At Down Right Concreting, we don’t consider our job complete until your premises is left clean and tidy. After the concreting work is done, we tidy up the entire area thoroughly, ensuring that your home environment is in an immaculate condition.

As specialised concrete contractors in Canberra, we ensure that all concreting jobs are done as per Australian standards. We deliver precisely the kind of concrete surface you want for your home without compromising on quality.

With a team that’s highly knowledgeable in project planning skills, we ensure that the concretingjob will be done in an organised manner. We will work with you to minimise any disruption to your day to day life while completing your new concrete.

## Transparent and reliable services

Down Right Concreting provides on-site quotes, which are valid for 30 days. It is our promise to remain loyal to our estimate without levying any kind of unexpected or hidden charges. Opting for concrete surfaces for your home is a great idea.

Whether you’re looking for new concrete layers or existing concrete resurfacing, get in touch with us via our website or call us on 0419 635 520 for a free quote.

pages.body:
Down Right Concreting undertakes specialised concreting works for a variety of commercial applications. As a fully licensed and insured company in Canberra, our commercial concrete services adhere to all WH&S and IRE regulations, exceeding quality expectations of all our clients. Find out more from a friendly consultant on 0419 635 520 or contact us.

As leading commercial concrete contractors in Canberra, we have built concrete car parks, large commercial slabs, extension slabs and a multitude of concrete structures meant solely for commercial use. When you work with us, you are guaranteed precise finishing at an exceptionally high quality. All our work is durable, visually appealing and adherent to Australian standards.

## Commercial Cement Contractors

As a construction material, concrete flooring has multiple benefits – especially in commercial spaces. For one, concrete is extremely strong, with the ability to withstand immense levels of compression. This is necessary as commercial spaces experience heavy footfalls. A weak surface can crack, leading to costly repairs that could have been avoided with the use of cement. What’s more, you can alter the typical grey look of concrete for an attractive finish. From using patterns and colours to obtain a unique finish, to exposing the rock and giving it a different texture, you can customise concrete surfaces to suit the decor of your environment.

## Professional and affordable commercial concreting services

At Down Right Concreting, we customise concrete surfaces as per your requirements. Before we begin with any work, we formulate a schedule that ensures the project remains within budgets and deadline. After the job is completed, we clean up the area and leave it in a condition that we would be happy with ourselves. If you want evidence of our expertise, you can visit any of our happy customers in Canberra. We have completed works at the McDonalds stores in Kippax, Mitchell and Majura Park. The Franklin Early Childhood Centre and Jewish Community Centre are also examples of our previous work.

For a beautiful, functional, low maintenance and reasonably priced concrete surface for your commercial space, speak to your local concrete contractors. Leave us a message with your requirements or call 0419 635 520 now.

Exposed aggregate concrete is another fabulous way to use concrete. It has become widely popular in driveways and pathways across the globe. They are deemed to be excellent substitutes for regular asphalt driveways. Down Right Concreting, Canberra, specialises in bringing these trendy concrete solutions to your doorstep.

## What is exposed aggregate concrete?

Exposed aggregate concrete leaves the natural textures of various crushed components like rocks, pebbles, silicate, quarry stones and shells exposed. As these components are all crushed, they retain a reasonable level of coarseness to make sure the surface is not slippery, while lending an appealing appearance. We seal the surface on completion to ensure its durability.

For your choice and convenience, we offer you a variety of rock sizes and colours to best suit your landscape and design. This also allows you to customise the appearance of your concrete driveways and concrete paths as you see fit.

## Why hire us?

Down Right Concreting is a leading concrete contractor in Canberra and with good reason:

- We employ unique techniques to achieve the best exposed aggregate finishes.
- We ensure timely completion of our projects and customer satisfaction of the same.
- We offer excellent landscaping solutions for key areas of your property that needs concrete works.
- Our employees are well trained professional who can get the job done.

Contact us today for top notch concreting services, or call 0419 635 520 for a quote.

Concrete flooring now includes a wide range of novel options, whether you are laying down a new pavement or renovating plain old concrete structures. If you’re looking for more than just a standard concrete paving finish, concrete stencils might be your answer.

## What are cement stencil patterns?

Selecting a creative concrete design for landscaping your driveway or pathways can be a trying task given the choices available. At Down Right Concreting, we aim to make your decision a whole lot easier.

Pattern concrete is an ideal choice for homes and commercial centres. As the name suggests, it is a patterned concrete that can either be coloured, sprayed on or stenciled onto wet cement. It requires a hand finish and needs to be sealed up on completion for best results – all of which we undertake.

We offer ample colours and patterns to choose from, giving you a set of unique ideas for your garden, poolside, stencil concrete driveway or pathways. These surfaces are also textured, serving as anti-slip solutions when wet.

- Friendly services from a family run business

To match customers’ decorative needs, concrete services have gone beyond the simple grey finish to include a more varied solution like the use of coloured and decorative concrete. This innovative solution can help you achieve the right look for your premises while making your driveways and other areas safer and less slippery.

Down Right Concreting, well-renowned concrete contractors Canberra, brings you this exclusive service combined with our years of experience in the industry.

## What is coloured concrete?

We combine an oxide component to the grey concrete at the plant to insure even coverage of finished colour. This finish is usually done in a cove pattern. The cove finish is an excellent way to create a more anti slippery surface as it adds texture to it. This finish is also sealed on completion, which helps sustain and prolong the durability of the colours used in the process.

Coloured concrete can be put to multiple uses. Apart from coloured concrete driveways adding aesthetic appeal to your exteriors, they can also be used for your outdoor entertaining areas.

## Choose the coloured concrete experts

We bring you all the advantages of working with a family run business and we also offer you other specialised solutions.

- Prompt and friendly service
- Ensuring quality products and services
- Specialists in stencil pattern concrete and other concrete works
- Well equipped and experienced team

Contact us to know more about our customised colour concrete services or call 0419 635 520 for a free consultation.

## The steps before concreting

Here at Down Right Concreting we recognise that the perfect concrete slab, driveway or specialised job isn’t fully reliant on the premium quality concreting service and concrete that we supply. Concreting jobs with the perfect execution, ultimately leading to the highest longevity, need to be levelled by accurate and experienced excavation services. That’s why we also have DRC Excavation Services.

## DRC Excavation Services

Excavation is a necessity in any construction or build. The existing concrete/grass/fill needs to be removed and levelled by premium quality excavators and the work needs to be performed by licensed, experienced and passionate excavator operators. We provide all the elements.

## Our services

We know that all excavation requirements are as important as each other. Whether it is levelling of a slight gradient for a driveway or the removal and excavation of an entire building, no job is too big or too small.

## Our equipment

We have an assortment of regularly serviced, safe excavation machines and equipment including;

- Bobcat
- Dingo for smaller areas
- 3 T excavator
- 16 T Tipper Truck

We have the professionals and the equipment to suit any excavation need.

## Why us?

DRC Excavation Services work hand in hand with Down Right Concreting. Eliminate the steps to complete your build and contracts by allowing us to work together.

Our service is exemplary. We are cost effective and premium and we care for nothing less than helping to build peoples' dreams and watching them grow in to a reality before their very eyes.

We are a premium quality, yet cost effective service. We adore working on private jobs and helping individuals or families.

## We offer:

- Customised quotes
- Low and affordable rates
- Exceptional machines and equipment
- Excellent communication and customer service
- A professional and passionate service

We know that construction and building can be stressful and a disruption to anyone’s life. That’s why our excavation and concreting service work perfectly in sync with each other.

If you need service with a smile, an array of flexible options, people who are happy to perform excellent excavations that fit around your schedule, and a fast and affordable service, contact DRC Excavation Services today for a free quote.

pages.body:
The list of advantages associated with a concrete driveway is a long one. Firstly, concrete is one of the strongest building materials available, providing a long-lasting solution for a wide variety of construction applications. It’s ability to resist wear and tear makes it one of the most widely-used materials on the globe.

One of Down Right’s specialties is that of concrete driveways. Most of our contribution to Canberra’s residential infrastructure has been in the form of premium quality concrete driveway finishes. This is due to a high demand for convenience when it comes to the entering and exiting of your home, with little to no maintenance required in order to keep your driveway in excellent condition. This is because it is impossible for weeds to grow through cement, unlike pavers and granite that leave gaps that are very quickly filled with small but resilient plants.

We offer a variety of decorative concrete driveways:

## Grey Concrete Driveway

The undisputed king of concrete driveways is the classic grey finish. This option offers a rustic feel that can accommodate almost any existing home or landscape design. Down Right Concrete is a specialist in the installation thereof, with an unparalleled dedication to doing the job right first time around.

## Exposed Aggregate Concrete Driveways

With natural textures like rocks, pebbles, silicate, quarry stones and shells left visible, exposed aggregate concrete is making waves in the global market as a welcomed alternative to regular asphalt driveways. Down Right offers a multitude of rock sizes and colours, giving you complete freedom in the design and execution of an exposed aggregate driveway.

## Stenciled Concrete Driveways

Concrete stenciling is the ultimate way to add a decorative flair to any concrete application. This option has seen massive success in both residential and commercial environments, offering amusing visual effects that are customisable right down to the colour and sizing. Stenciled concrete also offers a textured surface that provides extra grip and safety.

For more information about our concrete driveway finishes, get in touch with a friendly team member on 0419 635 520. If you have something in mind already, request an obligation-free quote or leave us a message with your enquiry.

pages.meta: Polished Concrete is not only functional, hypoallergenic, energy efficient it is stylish, easy to maintain and unique to each home or business. Polished…
pages.body:
Polished Concrete is not only functional, hypoallergenic, energy efficient it is stylish, easy to maintain and unique to each home or business. Polished concrete will stand the test of time and will enhance the design of your home or commercial property.

Using a concrete grinding machine, fine layers of concrete are removed to expose the aggregate underneath. The amount of grinding required will depend on the finished result as below.

Choosing between three levels of aggregate exposure, we can help you create a look that suits your lifestyle.

## Minimal Polished Concrete

This finish is designed to give you an industrial warehouse feel with minimal to zero aggregate exposure when finished. This process can be on new and existing slabs.

## Rustic Polished Concrete

Rustic concrete polishing will give you a hit and miss feature in your finished polished concrete slab. Every slab will have its own characteristics where more aggregate is at the surface compared to other areas. This will ensure a unique finish. You can choose between a low or high sheen finish by using resin pads before a densifier and sealer are applied. Not only hard wearing but stylish and easy to maintain. This process can be on new and existing slabs.

## Full stone exposure Polished Concrete

Full stone exposure is where all the aggregate is exposed and finished with a low or high sheen. Grouting is typically applied to any cracks or stone chips and polished to blend in with the concrete. A densifier is applied to harden the concrete making it spill proof, perfect for living and kitchen areas. This process is best for new slabs where the choice of rock and colour of the concrete can be personalised. We can complete full exposure to existing slabs although the finished product will be a surprise as we can’t see the level of aggregate underneath. A topping slab can be poured in some instances so that we can control the amount of aggregate and colours. Call now for a free quote and see what options are available to your home or business.

seoText.content:
## Residential Concrete

Concrete is a very popular residential construction material in Australia because of the numerous benefits it offers. At Down Right Concreting, we harness the enormous potential of concrete to ensure you get robust, functional and visually appealing surfaces.

## Commercial Concrete

At Down Right Concreting, we take up concreting works for different needs in commercial enterprises. We are a fully licensed and insured company in Canberra. Our commercial concrete services adhere to all OH&S and IRE regulations.We are skilled concrete contractors in Canberra.

## Polished Concrete

This can turn grey concrete into something special! Choose from our extensive range of patterns & colours to add life to new or existing concrete. Polished Concrete is not only functional, hypoallergenic, energy efficient it is stylish, easy to maintain and unique to each home or business. Polished concrete will stand the test of time and will enhance the design of your home or commercial property. Using a concrete grinding machine, fine layers of concrete are removed to expose the aggregate underneath. Sealing the final pass over with either a high or low sheen.

## Decorative Pattern & Colour Concrete

This can turn grey concrete into something special! Choose from our extensive range of patterns & colours to add life to new or existing concrete. Stencil Pattern Concrete Concrete flooring services now include a wide range of novel options whether you are laying down a new pavement or renovating plain old concrete structures. If you are looking for more than just standard concrete paving finishes, concrete stenciling might just be what you need.

## Exposed Aggregate

New concrete will be laid then washed so the rocks are left exposed as a finished product. Exposed aggregate concrete is the newest addition to concrete works. It has become widely popular in driveways and pathways across the globe. They are deemed to be excellent substitutes for regular asphalt driveways. Down Right Concreting, Canberra, specialises in bringing these trendy concrete solutions to your doorstep.

## Plain Grey

New concrete laid that can be coved finished, (a swirling pattern) or flat finished. Plain grey can also be broom finished ready for tiling. At Down Right Concreting, we don’t think that grey concrete is boring. Rather, we look at it as a platform to experiment, innovate and create a masterpiece. With our skill and expertise, we are able to make grey concrete look interesting and appealing. So, when you hire Down Right Concreting, you get a beautiful looking concrete surface without spending too much money.

pages.title: About Down Right Concreting
pages.meta: Established in 2003, Down Right Concreting creates beautiful, durable concrete surfaces across Canberra. Fully insured, HIA member, licensed with NSW Fair Trading.
pages.body:
Concrete surfaces, when done rightly look artistic, elegant and very beautiful. At Down Right Concreting, concrete contractors Canberra, we excel in doing it right.

We established Down Right Concreting in 2003. Over the years in service, we have enriched ourselves with tremendous amount of technical expertise and practical experiences. Today, we create fantastic concrete surfaces, whatever the design and pattern, suitable to your requirements.

## What do we offer?

At Down Right Concreting, we don’t consider concrete to be simply a kind of sludge formed by proportionate combination of cement, water and aggregates.

For us, the surface that you need us to work on is a canvas and concrete is our paint. Since we look at concrete this way, we are not restricted in our thought about the variety of patterns that this material can create. We push the boundaries of creativity so that concrete can come up with a unique effect on your surface.

Our expertise with concrete ranges over multiple services.

## Our concrete services

- Spray patterned concrete on new and existing concrete surfaces
- Exposed aggregate concrete
- House slabs
- Commercial slabs
- Wet stencil concrete
- Polished concrete
- Grey concrete with cove finish, broom finish or ready for paving/tiling
- Bobcat, Dingo and Tipper Hire

## Professional and effective services

Additionally, we specialise in creating a work flow such that your routine activities are not hampered drastically. We cause minimum disruption while ensuring that the quality of work does not suffer. We also pride ourselves on speedy completion of all concreting tasks.

We never consider our work to be complete until we have cleaned up after the job. So, when you hire us, you can be assured of end to end services; from identifying the requirements of the surface to leaving the surface clean.

## Licensed and quality conscious

Down Right Concreting is a fully insured company and a member of the HIA. We are licenced with the department of Fair Trading NSW. In every work we take up, we ensure compliance to WH&S and IRE stipulations so that you get a surface that is high in quality and as per all prescribed standards.

Contact us to know more about how we could help with your concreting needs. Alternatively, call 0419 635 520 for a consultation with our experts.

pages.meta: Concrete is very  versatile for enhancing outdoor spaces -  it offers unlimited flexibility in terms of shape, color and texture. It’s also cost-effective…
pages.body: Concrete is very versatile for enhancing outdoor spaces — it offers unlimited flexibility in terms of shape, colour and texture. Here are answers to the questions our customers ask most.

items.q: Where are you and what areas do you service?
items.a:
We are located in Royalla just outside of the ACT. We service all of Canberra, the Queanbeyan region, Yass and surrounding areas. If your area is not listed please contact us to see if it is viable.

All of Canberra, Burra, Captains Flat, Carwoola, Googong, Gundaroo, Hall, Jerrabomberra, Queanbeyan, Royalla, Sutton, Tharwa, Uriarra.

items.q: What is included in the base pricing for concrete supply and placement of a project?
items.a: Our base rate pricing is inclusive of formwork, steel mesh, chairs, jointex, concrete and labour to complete the desired works. Other provided services such as excavation and sub base are charged depending on if they are required and vary from project to project.

items.q: How soon can you start my project after approval of the quotation?
items.a: Typically, there is a 2-4 week period before the commencement of a new project depending on the current work load. Dave will be upfront with our current work load at the time of quoting. Some times are busy than others like the lead up to Christmas. We endeavour to stay as close as possible to the time frame provided at the time of approval. The weather is our worst enemy with time as rain and concreting don’t mix. If there is a delay we will contact you and keep you updated.

items.q: I have picked two or more colours and I can’t decide. Can you help me?
items.a: Choosing colours and patterns can be very time consuming and stressful. The colour charts are there to give you an indication of the colour but as you are dealing with a natural product there will be variations from the printed version. We have sample boards that you can take and place in different areas of your home to see how the colours and patterns will compliment your home. We are constantly updating as we complete new projects. Ask to see our samples.

items.q: How thick should my concrete be?
items.a: We work using a minimum of 100mm thick concrete for all of our standard concrete projects like driveways and paths, unless specified by an Engineer. We ensure we meet all Australian Standards. When we quote a project we ask what you will primarily be using the area for and will recommend a strength of concrete (25MPA or greater) and depth (100mm or greater) to suit. For example, a driveway used for parking a heavy vehicle could be 32MPA concrete and 125-150mm deep. While the path to your clothes line could be 100mm thick using 25MPA concrete.

We do not complete any concreting works without reinforcement mesh so we meet Australian Standards. Again depending on the type of concrete, the size of the area and what the area is to be used for, will determine what size of mesh we use. At a minimum we use SL62 for foot traffic concrete.

items.q: Do you remove old concrete, fill, garden beds and tree stumps?
items.a: Yes we do! Down Right Concreting has all the equipment to excavate your project to get it to the correct levels and shape ready for concreting. DRC Excavation Services is part of our business. We have a Bobcat, Dingo machine, 3 Tonne excavator and a 16T Tipper Truck. If a tree stump grinder is required we will take care of that for you, which of course you would have been quoted for.

items.q: How long before I can use my concrete?
items.a: Concrete requires curing time so 7-8 days is recommended. If your new concrete is to be sealed, then you may have to wait another couple of days so that the sealer has completely dried.
